input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines two time expressions; use the single time expression shown in the correction.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，医 is not normally used alone as the noun for a doctor; 医生 is the standard occupation noun.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看别的人：一看到别的人，when the meaning is “see,” use 看到 rather than 看.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 远远的地方：很远的地方，远远 cannot modify 地方 in this way; 很远 describes a distant place naturally.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人：病人，什么 asks which kind of patient; it cannot mean every patient in this sentence.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is the matching measure word for an individual plant.
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，follow the pronoun rule: after 神农 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes, use 他.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，repeat the noun with 这种 to refer clearly to the particular plant mentioned in the previous sentence.
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 病人吃都会觉得：病人吃了都会觉得，use 了 for the completed eating action that happens before the patients feel better.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去：走了三个月，put the duration after the verb, and use 了 because the three-month journey is presented as completed.

items.reason: 古代的时候 has the redundant time-expression structure that the teacher marks.
医 alone is not the appropriate occupation noun here; 医生 is correct.
看到 correctly replaces 看 for the intended meaning, but 别的人 remains wrong here; it should be 病人.
远远的地方 is an acceptable way to describe a faraway place.
什么病人 can express the intended broad reference in this context and was not marked by the teacher.
一个很漂亮的植物 is acceptable, although 一株 is a more specific and natural measure word.
After the immediately preceding mention of 神农, the teacher's reference rule requires 他, but the displayed text cuts off after 听说.
这种植物 clearly refers back to the particular plant just introduced.
了 correctly marks the eating as preceding the resulting feeling, but the displayed clause is cut off after 觉得.
走了三个月 has the correct duration placement and marks the completed journey.
